age.evidence: Wistar adult rats were maintained on a 12-h light/dark cycle

sex.evidence: The paper does not specify the sex of the rats used.

dosing.evidence: each rat received ibogaine 20 mg/kg ( I 20), 40 mg/kg ( I 40), or vehicle (saline) i.p., in different days in a counterbalance order; the wash-out period between doses was 3 days.

group_housing.evidence: housed four-six per cage before behavioral testing

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12-h light/dark cycle (lights on at 07.00 h)... Experimental sessions were conducted during the light period, between 10 AM and 4 PM

assays.assay_description: 6-hour polysomnographic recording (EEG + EMG) of wakefulness, light sleep, slow wave sleep, and REM sleep in chronically implanted rats freely moving in transparent home-cage-like recording chambers (40x30x20 cm) with wood shaving bedding and ad libitum food/water. Same animals tested under saline, I20, and I40 in counterbalanced order with 3-day wash-out.

application_type.evidence: each rat received ibogaine 20 mg/kg ( I 20), 40 mg/kg ( I 40), or vehicle (saline) i.p.

setup_habituation.evidence: After the animals had recovered from the preceding surgical procedures, they were adapted to the recording chamber for 1 week.

setup_restrain.evidence: The recordings were performed through a rotating connector, to allow the rats to move freely within the recording box.

food_restriction.evidence: housed individually in transparent cages... with water and food ad libitum

water_restriction.evidence: with water and food ad libitum

time_to_assay.evidence: Animals were treated with ibogaine (20 and 40 mg/kg) or vehicle, immediately before the beginning of the recordings.

sample_size.evidence: Eight animals selected for sleep experiments... Data are presented as mean ± standard error of eight rats. [within-subject design]

outcomes.summary: Ibogaine (20 and 40 mg/kg, i.p.) increased time spent in wakefulness and decreased SWS and REM sleep during the 6-h recording. REM sleep latency increased with 40 mg/kg. Effects on W and SWS were limited to the first 2 h, while REM suppression lasted throughout the recording.
outcomes.evidence: Compared to control, I 20 and I 40 increased the time spent in W... accompanied by a decrease in SWS time... total amount of REM sleep was diminished... REM sleep latency increased following I 40 administration.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Total time spent in W, LS, SWS, and REM sleep, as well as the duration and the number of episodes... Sleep latencies were also evaluated.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: the time spent in each state was analyzed separately in blocks of 2 h (0-2, 2-4, and 4-6 h)

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: The study analyzes total time and episode counts/durations, not transitions or sequences between states.

B4_ethological.evidence: Measures sleep/wake states (W, LS, SWS, REM) defined by EEG/EMG, not natural ethological behaviors.

B5_social.evidence: Animals were housed individually in transparent cages... for the recording.

B6_cognitive.evidence: The assay measures sleep/wake states, not learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The states of sleep and W were determined in 10 s epochs [scored manually from EEG/EMG using Spike 2].

B8_multivariate.evidence: Statistical significance... was evaluated utilizing one-way repeated measures analysis of variance

E1_environment_type.evidence: Animals were housed individually in transparent cages (40 x 30 x 20 cm) containing wood shaving material... Experimental sessions were conducted... in a sound-attenuated chamber.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material mentioned; only wood shavings.

E7_social_context.evidence: Animals were housed individually in transparent cages

E8_food_water.evidence: with water and food ad libitum

D1_continuity.evidence: each rat received ibogaine 20 mg/kg, 40 mg/kg, or vehicle (saline) i.p., in different days in a counterbalance order; the wash-out period between doses was 3 days. [3 separate 6-h sessions, each <6 h]

D2_session_duration.evidence: polysomnographic recordings on chronically prepared rats were performed in the light phase during 6 h

D3_recording_days.evidence: each rat received ibogaine 20 mg/kg, 40 mg/kg, or vehicle (saline) i.p., in different days in a counterbalance order [3 recording days per rat]

D4_baseline.evidence: each rat received ibogaine 20 mg/kg, 40 mg/kg, or vehicle (saline) i.p., in different days [within-subject design with vehicle session].

D6_circadian.evidence: recording... during 6 h [exactly 6 h, not >=6 h continuous of behavioural data span; treated as borderline — recordings were 6 h which does not exceed the >6h threshold for D6 (requires >=6 h per definition but D6 'span >=6 hours' — this single session is 6 h)]

assays.assay_description: Square arena 45x45x40 cm, transparent plastic walls, 35 lux. Locomotion (total distance) tracked with Ethovision XT 12.0 in 5-min bins over 120 min. Rearings, tremor, flat body posture, piloerection, forepaw treading, Straub tail, hind limb abduction, and head shake response scored by trained observer every 30 min.

application_type.evidence: each animal received I 20, I 40, or saline... i.p.

setup_habituation.evidence: As rats were not habituated to the OF before drug or vehicle administration

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were freely moving in the OF apparatus

food_restriction.evidence: Standard OF test with no food in apparatus; food was ad libitum in home cage but not accessible during testing.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard OF test with no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: starting immediately after the drug or vehicle administration

sample_size.evidence: Eighteen naive (not operated) rats were used... each animal received I 20, I 40, or saline ( n = 6 per group)

outcomes.summary: Ibogaine 20 mg/kg increased total locomotor activity vs control, while 40 mg/kg reduced locomotion and rearing only in the first 5 min and induced tremor and flat body posture immediately post-injection (resolved by 60 min). Head shake response was unchanged at both doses.
outcomes.statistics: Locomotion treatment F(2,15)=8.7, p<0.01; treatmentxtime F(46,345)=1.43, p<0.05. Rearing F(2,15)=4.0, p<0.05. Tremor F(2,15)=35.9, p<0.0001. Flat body posture F(2,15)=9.3, p<0.01. HSR F(2,15)=1.1, p=0.36.
outcomes.evidence: I 20 elicited a significant increment in the locomotor activity compared to control... I 40 elicited a significant decrease... during the first 5 min... tremor and flat body posture were significantly present immediately after I 40 injection... HSR did not reveal significant difference.

B1_num_measures.evidence: total distance traveled... number of rearings... tremor, flat body posture, piloerection, hind limb abduction, Straub tail... forepaw treading... number of HSR

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: total distance traveled in meters (m) during 120 min (5 min bin)... Specific behaviors were assessed... every 30 min during 2 h

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: rearings, tremor, flat body posture, forepaw treading, piloerection, HSR — natural ethological behaviours scored as distinct acts

B6_cognitive.evidence: No learning or memory component in this OF test.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Ethovision XT 12.0 software [position tracking only; behaviours scored by trained investigator].

B8_multivariate.evidence: data analyzed by two-way ANOVA or one-way ANOVA [no PCA/multivariate].

E1_environment_type.evidence: An OF apparatus consisting of a square area (45 cm wide x 45 cm long x 40 cm high) with transparent plastic walls

E2_shelter.evidence: Definitionally absent — open field has no shelter.

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding mentioned in the OF arena.

E6_spatial.evidence: square area (45 cm wide x 45 cm long x 40 cm high)

E7_social_context.evidence: Each animal was tested individually in the OF.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the OF apparatus during testing.

D1_continuity.evidence: tested for 2 h after ibogaine treatment... were used only once.

D2_session_duration.evidence: during 120 min (5 min bin), starting immediately after the drug or vehicle administration

D4_baseline.evidence: rats were not habituated to the OF before drug or vehicle administration

D5_followup.evidence: Recording started immediately after injection and lasted 2 h; no >=24 h follow-up.

judge_notes: Two distinct assays retained: (1) polysomnographic sleep/wake recording (6 h, n=8, within-subject), and (2) open field test (2 h, n=18, between-subject). Candidate qwen omitted the sleep recording assay; candidates glm and gptoss were used to reconstruct it.

For the sleep assay, D1 set to 'Multiple discrete sessions' (each rat tested across 3 days with different drug conditions, counterbalanced) rather than 'Continuous monitoring' since each session was 6 h not >=6 h continuous and was treated as discrete dosing sessions.
B1 for sleep assay scored 7+ (4 states x time/episodes/duration + latencies = >=7 measures, supported by Table 1).
Setup_habituation for sleep assay scored 'yes' based on 1-week adaptation to recording chamber post-surgery.
Sex scored as not_reported with high confidence — the paper repeatedly says 'rats' but never specifies sex.

D6 for sleep assay (6 h recording) scored 0 since rubric requires >=6 h for 'Yes' but in the rubric D6 says 'span >=6 hours' — kept conservative as 0 since recording is exactly 6 h and described as terminating at 6 h; ambiguous boundary.
